parrafo_1.es: Kyle Withrow cocina para familias y grupos en Naples, desde una cena tranquila para dos hasta una fiesta de compromiso para decenas de invitados. Llega con el menú planeado, cocina fresco en el momento y se encarga de todo: compra, preparación, servicio y limpieza.
parrafo_1.en: Kyle Withrow cooks for families and groups around Naples, from a quiet dinner for two to an engagement party for dozens of guests. He shows up with the menu already planned, cooks everything fresh on site, and handles it all: shopping, prep, service and cleanup.

parrafo_2.es: Cada menú se adapta a lo que el cliente pide, incluyendo alergias y preferencias alimentarias, y el resultado se nota: calificación de 5.0 en 18 reseñas de Google, con clientes que repiten para distintos eventos y los recomiendan a su familia.
parrafo_2.en: Every menu is adjusted to what the client actually wants, allergies and dietary preferences included, and it shows: a 5.0 rating across 18 Google reviews, with clients who come back for different events and recommend him to their own family.

texto.es: Cuéntanos la fecha, cuántos invitados y qué tipo de evento es. Respuesta directa al +1 (239) 707-2148, sin formularios.
texto.en: Tell us the date, the guest count and the kind of event it is. Direct reply at +1 (239) 707-2148, no forms involved.

texto.es: Definimos los platos según tus gustos, alergias y presupuesto, con la opción de ajustar antes del día del evento.
texto.en: We put together the dishes around your taste, allergies and budget, with room to adjust before the day of the event.

texto.es: El chef llega con todo lo necesario y cocina fresco en tu cocina o venue, el mismo día del evento.
texto.en: The chef arrives with everything needed and cooks fresh in your kitchen or venue, the same day as the event.

texto.es: Montamos la mesa, servimos cada plato y dejamos la cocina como la encontramos. Tú solo te sientas a disfrutar.
texto.en: We set the table, serve every course and leave the kitchen the way we found it. You just sit down and enjoy it.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza según el menú, el número de invitados y el tipo de servicio. Llama o escribe y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on the menu, the guest count and the type of service. Call or text and we will walk you through the details, no obligation.

texto.es: El chef cocina en vivo en tu casa cualquier noche de la semana: desde una cena íntima para dos hasta una celebración familiar.
texto.en: The chef cooks live in your home any night of the week, from an intimate dinner for two to a family celebration.

texto.es: Servicio a la mesa, buffet o estaciones, con entrega, montaje y limpieza incluidos para tu boda, compromiso o fiesta privada.
texto.en: Plated service, buffet or food stations, with delivery, setup and cleanup included for your wedding, engagement party or private celebration.

texto.es: Menús armados a tu gusto, con opciones sin gluten, vegana, halal y kosher cuando se necesitan.
texto.en: Menus built around what you like, with gluten-free, vegan, halal and kosher options handled when you need them.

titulo.es: Bar y alquiler para tu evento

texto.es: Bartender, barra abierta, brindis y renta de vajilla, cristalería y mantelería para completar el evento.
texto.en: Bartender, open bar, champagne toast, and rentals for china, glassware and linens to complete the event.

pie.es: ¿Aún no sabes qué quieres servir? Cuéntanos la ocasión y te proponemos un menú.
pie.en: Not sure yet what you want to serve? Tell us the occasion and we will suggest a menu.

items.quote: Kyle and Taryn provide the best catering services every time. My family has used them for multiple events and dinners now but this was my first time personally hiring them for our engagement party and they were so wonderful and easy to work with.

My family and I were staying in Naples on vacation and hired Kyle for his private chef services. He could not have been more efficient in terms of communication, planning, and organization. He showed up well-prepared and cooked us a truly …

Kyle was such a pleasure. Food was beautifully presented and delicious. I would recommend him to anyone needing a personal chef for any type of event big or small! He responded quickly, edited our menu due to a food preference, and provided us a great experience.
